description_en: Retrieves monitoring metrics for a lightweight database instance
description_zh: 查询数据库实例监控信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-instance-metric-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --metric-name MySQL_MemCpuUsage --start-time 2022-09-06T04:04Z --end-time 2022-09-07T04:04Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseInstanceMetricData

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to get the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:

`MySQL_MemCpuUsage`: The CPU utilization and memory usage of the instance, as a percentage of the total resources of the operating system.

`MySQL_DetailedSpaceUsage`: The total, data, log, temporary, and system disk space usage of the instance.

`MySQL_Sessions`: The number of active and total connections.

`MySQL_IOPS`: The IOPS of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
指标名称。取值范围：

MySQL_MemCpuUsage：实例CPU使用率（占操作系统总数）和MySQL实例内存使用率（占操作系统总数）。
MySQL_DetailedSpaceUsage：实例总空间使用量、数据空间、日志空间、临时空间和系统空间。
MySQL_Sessions ：当前活跃连接数，当前总连接数。
MySQL_IOPS ：实例的IOPS（每秒IO请求次数）
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

The time in the console is displayed in UTC+8
parameters.help_zh:
监控结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

The time in the console is displayed in UTC+8
parameters.help_zh:
监控开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的时间
parameters.name: end_time
